Intro.Title: Hello, I'm Johans.
Intro.Text: I'm a full-stack developer with +5 years of experience. I enjoy building sites & apps. My focus is in JS/TS world.

About.Title: About me
About.Bio1: I am a dedicated code enthusiast and a passionate programmer, deeply committed to upholding the principles of best practices and clean code architecture.
About.Bio2: Beyond the realm of code and projects, I am ceaselessly driven by an insatiable thirst for personal and professional growth. Each day presents an opportunity to surpass yesterday's version of myself, as I tirelessly strive for self-improvement. This journey embodies my enduring commitment to mastery in both personal and professional aspects.
About.Bio3: My reverence for programming goes beyond its utilitarian function; it is a medium through which I stimulate my intellect, conquer challenges, and foster creativity. This profession is not just a livelihood; it is a lifelong commitment that continually nurtures my mind through problem-solving and dynamic challenges.
About.Bio4: Join me as we explore the intricate symphony of code, creativity, and unwavering growth. Let's collaboratively transform challenges into triumphs and lines of code into exceptional solutions.

Projects.Title: My Projects
Projects.Revius: Lets users create and edit reviews about certain products on the internet, it also has the data of the reviews from other retailers websites. (Still in development)
Projects.Sorted Collections: Open-source library for JavaScript/TypeScript with SortedList, SortedSet, and SortedMap — zero runtime dependencies, inspired by Python's sortedcontainers.
Projects.Datoteca: TypeScript library for generating realistic and localized test data for Chile
Projects.Falta 1: PWA made with React and TypeScript, it allows users to create and search for sports events in their city, it also has a chat system and a notification system.

Graduated Computer Science.Title: Graduado de Ingeniería en Informática
Graduated Computer Science.Description: I graduated after 4 years of studying. I immediately found a job as a web developer.

Freelance Web Developer.Title: Freelance Web Developer
Freelance Web Developer.Description: I worked as a freelance web developer for about 3 years where I made a couple of web pages and sites, landing pages, and a user maintainer for a private server of Lineage 2 game. I also upskilled to the full stack.

Full-Stack Developer.Title: Full-Stack Developer
Full-Stack Developer.Description: I worked as a full-stack developer working at Evalueserve Chile. My stack includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma and MongoDB.

Software Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Title: Software Developer at Evalueserve Chile
Software Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Description: I worked as a full-stack developer on applications for clients like Diageo, Heineken, and Gates Ventures, focusing on data visualization and analytics dashboards for decision-making.

Senior Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Title: Senior Developer at Evalueserve Chile
Senior Developer at Evalueserve Chile.Description: As a senior developer, I worked on full-stack applications for clients like Walmart US, Intuit India, and McDonald's US, integrating large amounts of data to build dashboards and advanced visualizations.

Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at.Title: Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at BICE Hipotecaria
Senior Software Engineer | Tech Lead at.Description: I started by building Carpeta Digital, an internal system for managing credit-related documents, and led the migration of the authentication system from on-premise Keycloak to Auth0 for over 15,000 clients. Later, as Tech Lead, I led a team of 6 developers on integration projects during the Bice and Security merger, including rolling out the Toku payment gateway for over 30,000 clients.

Senior Software Engineer at Scotiabank C.Description: Frontend and backend software development, working on a data privacy project for backoffice, a web payment button, and a flow acquisition project focused on Agentic AI Development.
